newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Brink's buys Venezuela's Custravalca for $68.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Brink's buys Venezuela's Custravalca for $68.1 mln.

text.p: U.S. security group Brink's International Inc acquired Venezuelan holding Custravalca for $68.1 million at an auction on Monday, Venezuelan State Deposits Guarantee Fund (Fogade) President Esther de Margulis said.
Brink's paid $8.1 million above the base price of $60 million for Custravalca, a company founded in 1958 with interests in insurance and security business.
The other bidder was U.K. security group Securicor Plc in association with Venezuela's Vicasa.
The consortium Securicor-Vicasa presented a bland bid.
The auction was the fourth major one in a week by Fogade, following the sale of two local leading banks, Banco de Venezuela and Banco Consolidado, and Colombia's Banco Tequendama.

Brink's held 15 percent of Custravalca "but we chose to offer these 15 percent (to Fogade) in order to be able to buy the whole of Custravalca," Ronald Muir, Brink's Latin America vice- president for operations, told reporters.
He said Brink's planned to bring new technology to Custravalca.
